title: Did the LLM Answer the Question? A Semantic Reconstruction Game for Jailbreak Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which depends on correctly identifying responses that fulfill prohibited requests. Existing evaluators can mistake refusals or topically related responses for successful attacks. We show that changing only the judge LLM can alter reported ASR by up to $82$ percentage points. We introduce the semantic reconstruction game, a training-free evaluator that decomposes compliance judgments into constrained semantic comparisons. Given only a response, an LLM reconstructs the request answered by its substantive content, excluding information merely repeated or refused. The game compares this reconstruction against similar decoy requests to determine whether it matches the original request, allowing abstention when neither candidate matches. translated_title: 大语言模型回答了问题吗？一种用于越狱评估的语义重构游戏
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击通常使用攻击成功率（ASR）进行评估，而这依赖于正确识别出那些真正满足禁止请求的回复。现有的评估器可能将拒绝类回复或仅在主题上相关的回复误判为成功的攻击。我们证明，仅更换评判所用的LLM就可能使报告的ASR变化高达82个百分点。我们提出了语义重构游戏，这是一种无需训练的评估器，它将合规性判断分解为受约束的语义比较。在仅给定一个回复的情况下，由LLM根据其实质性内容重构出该回复所回答的请求，并排除其中仅仅是重复或拒绝的信息。该游戏将这一重构结果与相似的诱饵请求进行比较，以判断其是否与原始请求匹配，并在两个候选请求都不匹配时允许弃权。在三个现成的LLM评判器上，该游戏相对于人工标注取得了最低的平均错误率……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的“语义重构游戏”评估方法，通过让LLM从回复中重构其实际回答的请求并与诱饵请求进行受限语义比较来判断越狱是否成功，从而避免将拒绝或仅主题相关的回复误判为成功攻击，大幅提升攻击成功率评估的准确性（不同评判模型间ASR差异可达82个百分点）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a training-free "semantic reconstruction game" evaluator that reconstructs the request actually answered by a response and compares it against decoy requests via constrained semantic matching, substantially improving jailbreak attack success rate evaluation accuracy over existing judge-based methods.
